name: security-pack
description: One security-methodology skill: security-posture-record (construct, update, and maintain a durable, tiered security-assessment record whose load-bearing security claims are tracked to evidence - explicit invariants, a per-claim verification obligation, adversarial verification, evidence-backed finding states, and residual-risk closure, re-verified as the system changes). Leans on the Ops Pack - security-architect for consult/review, ground-truth-gates for the executable enforcement gate - which it names but does not bundle. Installable separately; designed to run alongside `ops-pack`. Few dense rules, executable gates over long prose. Registers no hooks.
